prompt:
Build the browser application described below.

Requirement:
With Work, Remaining Work, and % Complete initially empty, entering only Work sets Remaining Work to the same value and sets % Complete to 0%.

Implementation interface:
Implement one self-contained HTML page using vanilla JavaScript with no external resources. Render an editable work package with accessible fields named Work, Remaining Work, and % Complete plus an accessible Save button. All three fields start empty. Values must remain visible after Save. Return only raw HTML.
